about_the_game:
Woven Legend

"Step into the web of destiny with the threads of the Weaver herself. The Woven Legend supporter pack is the ultimate expression of devotion to the Woven, offering unparalleled cosmetic enhancements steeped in the mystique of the Weaver’s dark and enigmatic power. From the ethereal Shroud of the Woven Disciple to the mesmerizing Thread Strider pet, this pack transforms you into a living legend of Eterra.

**Note:** This pack includes all cosmetic items from the *Woven Traveler*, *Woven Templar*, and *Woven Vanquisher* packs, but does not carry over Epoch Points from those tiers."

Woven Traveler Pack

Woven Templar Pack

Woven Vanquisher Pack

Armor Set - Shroud of the Woven Disciple

Drape yourself in the Weaver’s embrace with the Shroud of the Woven Disciple. This intricately crafted armor set radiates with eldritch energy, its dark hues intertwined with glowing teal accents and arachnid-inspired motifs. With its otherworldly presence, this set transforms you into a harbinger of the Weaver’s will.

Footprint - Weaver Footprint

Mark your passage with threads of celestial silk. The Weaver Footprints leave behind radiant star-like patterns, interconnected with shimmering lines of energy, as if the Weaver herself were guiding your steps through time.

Evade - Spirit Hawk

Dodge with the swiftness of an avian spirit. The Spirit Hawk evade cosmetic summons spectral wings of glowing energy, leaving a graceful yet fierce impression of avian power with every movement.

Evade - Cherry Blossom

Evade with elegance and beauty. The Cherry Blossom evade cosmetic trails a flourish of vibrant petals and ethereal energy, embodying a moment of serene artistry even in the chaos of battle.

Evade - Umbral Crow

Shroud yourself in shadows with the Umbral Crow evade cosmetic. Each movement summons a swarm of dark crows, leaving a haunting trail of mystery and menace in your wake.

Evade - Seismic

Shake the very ground beneath your feet. The Seismic evade cosmetic creates a trail of shattered earth and rising stone, a testament to your unyielding strength.

Pet - Thread Strider

Summon the Thread Strider, a loyal arachnid companion infused with the Weaver’s power. Its crystalline carapace and ethereal energy make it a striking and otherworldly presence by your side, a true embodiment of the Woven faction’s legacy.

300 EP

Digital currency to further customize your journey. Use these points to purchase additional cosmetics from the in-game cosmetic shop.

Woven Legend Forum Badge

You were here for Season 2, and your journey is a part of your story. Showcase your travels with the Woven Legend Forum Badge.

Please note, cosmetic items are not available in offline mode
